# TokDown

> Free online video downloader and media tools: download TikTok videos without watermark in HD, save TikTok photo slideshows, download Facebook and Twitter/X videos, grab YouTube thumbnails, compress videos and convert MP4 to GIF. No login, no app. Available in English, German, Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil) and Indonesian.

Site: https://tokdown.org · Contact: support@tokdown.org · Not affiliated with TikTok, ByteDance, Meta, X or Google.

## Tools
- [TikTok video downloader](https://tokdown.org/): paste a TikTok link, get the MP4 without watermark (HD or SD) or the sound as MP3.
- [TikTok photo / slideshow downloader](https://tokdown.org/photo-downloader): every image of a TikTok photo post in full size, individually or all at once.
- [Facebook video downloader](https://tokdown.org/facebook-video-downloader): public Facebook videos, Reels and fb.watch links as MP4, HD when available.
- [Twitter / X video downloader](https://tokdown.org/twitter-video-downloader): videos and GIFs from public tweets, highest bitrate first; photo tweets as a gallery.
- [YouTube thumbnail downloader](https://tokdown.org/youtube-thumbnail-downloader): all thumbnail sizes of a YouTube video up to 1280×720, with direct URL copy.
- [Video compressor](https://tokdown.org/video-compressor): shrink MP4, MOV, WebM in the browser with ffmpeg.wasm; nothing is uploaded; up to 500 MB.
- [MP4 to GIF converter](https://tokdown.org/mp4-to-gif): clip, frame rate and width controls, palette-optimised GIFs, in the browser.
- [All tools](https://tokdown.org/tools)

## Languages
- German: https://tokdown.org/de · Arabic: https://tokdown.org/ar · Spanish: https://tokdown.org/es · Portuguese (Brazil): https://tokdown.org/pt · Indonesian: https://tokdown.org/id
- All tools, /tools, /guide, /about and eight guides (watermark, MP3, iPhone, Android, PC and Mac, slideshow, missing Save video option, drafts) exist in every language at the same path under the language prefix (e.g. https://tokdown.org/es/guide/download-tiktok-on-pc). The other guides are English only.

## Facts worth citing
- Downloads are streamed through TokDown's server in a single pass; no video is stored.
- TikTok media comes from a third-party API (TikWM) with TikTok's public page as fallback; when that API is busy, users are asked to retry. X videos come from the public embed data. Facebook is often blocked for data-centre servers.
- The site is free and funded by Adsterra ads (banners, a social bar, and a pop-under that opens only after a download result).
- Only public content can be fetched. Private, age-restricted or group-only posts are not supported.
- The compressor and GIF converter run entirely in the visitor's browser (WebAssembly); files never leave the device.
- No account, no app, no browser extension is required for any tool.
